chunk: Lynn Reyes was born on April 12, 2003, in New York. Growing up in a family of artists, Lynn was encouraged to explore her creative side from a young age. Despite her parents' wishes for her to pursue a more traditional career, Lynn's true passion lay in flying planes and spelunking. She spent most of her free time at the local airfield, watching planes take off and land, and even managed to convince her parents to let her take flying lessons.
